source.stem: Decide whether the following statements are correct. Mark “√” for correct answers and “×” for wrong answers. (1) Objects that can move must be living things.

hinge.title: Measure a straight object with a scale without introducing placement, eye-position, or unit-reporting error.

intelligence.enrichment: To measure length with a scale, place the scale in contact with the object along its length, read the scale with the eye directly above the endpoint, and write both the number and the unit. correct placement and direct eye position -> reliable scale reading with number and unit The learner correctly applies this rule: To measure length with a scale, place the scale in contact with the object along its length, read the scale with the eye directly above the endpoint, and write both the number and the unit. The number beside the endpoint is enough; scale placement, eye position, and units do not affect the answer.

spec.instruction: Write one new grades 6 Science question. Chapter: Measurement of length and motion. The student must decide: Measure a straight object with a scale without introducing placement, eye-position, or unit-reporting error. Use an Indian school or home setting and Indian names. Keep the source language register. Change the numbers, materials, or everyday situation. Do not copy the source stem. Recalculate the key. Do not print mix-up labels, hinge codes, node codes, or the word CANDIDATE. If the stem numbers activities 1..n, every number must appear in an option (or in a structured part's first-class options). Two-tier (choose, then reason) is welcome: put A/B/C on part.options, not typed into part text.
